messages:
Anand: Quick sync — I put together a compact 'traffic light' checklist for GA readiness (SLA / docs / support / monitoring / pricing). React with :green_circle: / :yellow_circle: / :red_circle: and call out blockers.

Maya: Copying checklist below. Goal: all greens or documented mitigations. Short thread so we can move fast.

Maya: ```
- SLA: 99.9% availability for hosted API; p50/p95 latency targets defined; error budget policy in sla.md — owner: Rory
- Docs: Quickstart, API reference, migration guide, error-code matrix — owner: Sofia
- Support: 24/7 oncall coverage for first 72h post-GA, support runbook, billing dispute playbook — owner: Jules (oncall)
- Monitoring: per-model latency dashboards, token-cost burn alerts, error-budget burn rate alerts — owner: Maya
- Pricing: published tiers, burst policy, default quotas, billing edge case doc — owner: Anand
```

Rory: SLA note — infra can meet p50 targets if we cap max tokens to 1024 for GA (limits tail). I'll add autoscale safeguards and a fallback variant with quantized model to reduce latency spikes.

Sofia: Docs status — quickstart + reference done. Examples + migration guide are in draft, ETA EOD tomorrow. Will request review from @docs when ready.

Jules (oncall): Support: we need an extra engineer for first week (EMEA overlap). I'll draft a rota + escalation matrix. Without that I'm marking support as :yellow_circle:.

Maya: Monitoring: PR with alert rules is at PR #432. Need eng-sre review for flapping thresholds. Token-cost thresholds need workload baseline before finalizing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — rollout window 2h. Automated rollback on >1% error-rate in canary.

Anand: Decisions / current states: 1) SLA -> :yellow_circle: (Rory to confirm infra PR today). 2) Docs -> :yellow_circle: (Sofia ETA EOD). 3) Support -> :yellow_circle: (Jules drafting rota). 4) Monitoring -> :yellow_circle: (PR pending eng-sre). 5) Pricing -> :red_circle: (legal review needed; pricing doc not published). Owners: please update your line items in the checklist doc with a short mitigation note if you cannot reach green.

Sofia: Posting docs checklist link: https://confluence.redwood/docs/ga-docs-checklist (will add exact file names and reviewer tags).

Maya: Action items summary: Rory -> infra PR + autoscale config; Sofia -> publish examples + request review; Jules -> rota + escalation matrix; Anand -> legal review for pricing + publish draft tiers; Maya -> follow up with eng-sre on alert thresholds. Ping this thread when completed so I can re-run the SLO sim.

Rory: :white_check_mark: I'll own the infra PR. ETA 18:00 PT today. I'll include the max-tokens cap and a canary-specific config.

Jules (oncall): I'll draft rota by EOD and ping @hannah for EMEA coverage. Also adding a short billing playbook for common disputes.

Anand: If we get SLA/docs/monitoring/support to green, we can flip the GA feature flag. Pricing must be cleared but can be staggered (soft-launch pricing placeholders with legal caveats). Reconvene 12:00 UTC tomorrow for final go/no-go. :calendar:

Maya: Adding a quick note — please add explicit rollback trigger definitions to your items (e.g., error-rate percentage, token-cost spike threshold). That speeds the decision.

Sofia: Will add rollback triggers to docs PR.

Rory: Adding rollback triggers to infra PR as well.

Jules (oncall): Rota + escalation matrix: drafting now. Will share in this thread when ready.

Anand: Thanks everyone. Short and focused — keep updates here.
